final_answer: BFA suppresses a common Hallmark program across all four human cell types. The most consistently downregulated pathways were Epithelial Mesenchymal Transition, TNF-alpha Signaling via NF-kB, UV Response Dn, KRAS Signaling Up, Inflammatory Response, Angiogenesis, TGF-beta Signaling, Interferon Gamma Response, Notch Signaling, and Apical Junction. All of these were negatively enriched (NES < 0, FDR < 0.05) in BFA-treated samples and appeared across all 4 cell types; EMT, TNF-alpha/NF-kB, UV Response Dn, KRAS Signaling Up, Inflammatory Response, Angiogenesis, TGF-beta Signaling, Interferon Gamma Response, and Notch Signaling were each suppressed in 21 of 24 BFA contrasts, with median NES values around -1.7 to -2.5. This pattern supports BFA as a broad secretory-pathway disruptor that dampens inflammatory, adhesion/junction, developmental, and stress-response programs. The analysis is limited to the provided DESeq2 results and Hallmark gene sets; it does not prove direct causality for any one pathway.
